name: 89129 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89129 (Las Vegas) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89129 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
